## What changes

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the build, test or game scenarios you actually ran, including platform and map/mode where relevant. State what remains untested. Include screenshots or a short recording for visible/input changes.

## Review notes

- [ ] The change has a focused scope and preserves original credits/notices.
- [ ] New code or assets include source and license information where needed.
- [ ] Validation claims match the checks performed.
